auto_confirm_online.title: Confirm bookings made by the customer automatically
auto_confirm_online.description: When on, an appointment the customer booked herself — online or through an automation such as WhatsApp — is created already confirmed, so nobody has to accept it one by one. Turn it off to review every one of them before it counts. Required on purpose: this command carries no default, so an empty payload cannot decide the salon's policy by omission.
